description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM leave API module. The class implements data serialization for employee leave information, including properties like leave ID, date, duration, status, leave request, leave type, start and end times, and duration type. It uses traits and annotations for API documentation and serialization purposes.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee leave data according to the API schema, encapsulating leave details, status, type, and timings for external representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeLeaveModel with a Leave entity and configures properties for serialization, including filters and attribute mappings.
